    if (!next_hdr)

    if (buffer_end - next_chr == 2)
        goto process;
    header_start[n_headers++] = next_chr;
    header_start[n_headers++] = next_hdr;
    p = next_hdr + 2;

```

For buffer_end - next_chr == 2: buffer_end - (R+2) == 2 -> R == buffer_end - 4 = 32766 - 4 = 32762.

So if the If-Modified-Since header '\r' is at 32762, then p = 32764, and in the next iteration buffer_end - next_chr = 32766 - 32764 = 2, triggering `goto process`.
